name: run-progress
title: RunProgress
description: Progress card of a running test (TestRun, AgentTestRun): the big count done, what runs now, one segment per step, the counts by result and a step control.

a11y.pattern: <section aria-label="Progress"> with the count as text, a role="img" bar named by the count and a polite live region for the current step
aria: The section's accessible name is the `label` option ("Progress" by default); it is the only naming API and wins over a passed aria-label

`busy` (off by default) marks the bar as updating: aria-busy="true" on the role="img" bar only, never on an ancestor of the live region, so step announcements are not affected; the attribute is absent otherwise
The segment bar is role="img" named "5 of 7 test steps done"
"Now calling" is aria-live="polite": the current step is announced when it changes
Each count writes its word next to a decorative icon; the current segment's pulse stops under reduced motion
The note is before the counts and the step control in the DOM, so the reason ("Paused…") is read before "Step forward"; CSS order shows it last, and it is not focusable
